equivalenceArgument: The existing VTK method maps lower/upper query coordinates to clamped bin indices and visits every bin in their Cartesian product.
Each axis is partitioned by one shared monotone np.linspace endpoint array, preserving original outer endpoints; neighboring closed tiles share exactly the same numeric boundary.
For monotone endpoint-to-bin mapping, the union of adjacent inclusive bin ranges equals the original inclusive bin range. All Cartesian-product tiles therefore have the same visited-bin union.
The only per-bin operation in this VTK method is collecting original cell IDs. Final sorted np.unique produces the same set and order as the existing ground helper.
No triangle geometry is filtered by the tiler. Outside-dataset clamped-bin behavior is intentionally preserved.
assumptions: Upstream VTK9.3.1 vtkStaticCellLocator, built immutable single-owner dataset/locator, unchanged numeric query AABB.
Ground setup consumes sorted unique IDs, not the original query visitation order. This helper must not replace per-tick first-contact ordering.
Finite bounds and declared tile/ID caps must pass; any guard failure is setup unavailable, not free space.
